messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@integracom.com>, Integracom Solutions <integracom-success@integracom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration checkpoint — SDK auth, streaming & tool calling

Hi everyone,

Quick weekly checkpoint ahead of Thursday's sync. This thread will capture the latest statuses, owners, and open risks for the mutual action plan (MAP) focused on SDK/API integration, auth, streaming behavior, and tool-calling compatibility. High level agenda for the 30m call:

- Confirm SDK auth flow (client creds + token refresh) and delta on test coverage
- Streaming behavior in the client (partial tokens, reconnect semantics)
- Tool-calling integration surface & sample payloads
- Demo window + close timeline alignment

Current open items (owner - short note):
- SDK auth: Monica - deliver auth_test_report and confirm refresh cadence (ETA Wed EOD)
- API spec: Integracom - confirm final field names for tool-calls (ETA Wed noon)
- Streaming: Karthik - validate reconnect/backpressure behavior in staging (ETA Thu AM)
- MAP doc: Alex - attach updated MAP with proposed close timeline and milestones

Attachments: MAP_Integracom_v2.xlsx (proposed milestones & responsibilities), integration_flow.drawio.png (high-level flow).

Please reply with any changes to owners or dates. If no conflicts, we'll keep the same owners and review progress on Thu 07/09 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clear agenda. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- API spec: we've uploaded a draft of the tool-calling payloads to our shared folder and highlighted two breaking-field candidates. We'll email the exact lines to Monica by Wed 11:00 PT.
- Demo window: Thu 10:00 PT works for our engineers. Can you confirm the staging endpoint you'll use?

We don't need a deeper dive on streaming yet; if Karthik sees anything in staging we can triage on the call.

Attachments: none in this message (see Integracom shared drive link).

Best,
Sarah Bloom

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@integracom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration checkpoint — SDK auth, streaming & tool calling

Alex / Sarah — quick status update from the SDK side:

- Auth: Completed client-credentials implementation; token refresh is working against our internal token-service. I ran a light test matrix (client creds, expired token, refresh race) and attached the results as auth_test_report.pdf. Observations: refresh race condition handled with single-flight mutex; occasional 500 on token-service under burst which we flagged to infra.
- Tool-calling: I reviewed Integracom draft payloads. Two minor field name mismatches (payload.metadata.request_id vs ours requestId) — proposing we accept Integracom's naming for parity; we'll add a thin adapter in the SDK (ETA Fri EOD).
- Streaming: Karthik and I validated reconnect semantics; streaming drops on transient network are retried with backoff. Karthik will push a staging build before Thu's demo.

Open asks:
- Integracom: can you confirm the staging endpoint URL and an account token for our smoke tests?
- Alex: please confirm whether the MAP milestone "Integration demo" should be recorded and shared (we can capture short video).

Attachments: auth_test_report.pdf (results & logs).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior SDK Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration checkpoint — SDK auth, streaming & tool calling

Thanks for the updates — short summary and next steps from today's triage:

Summary:
- SDK auth: Monica delivered auth_test_report.pdf; noted token-service 500s under burst and single-flight refresh handling is in place.
- API/tool-calls: Integracom confirmed payload naming; Monica will ship SDK adapter by Fri EOD (target met).
- Streaming: Karthik pushed staging build; smoke succeeded locally but we want to monitor for edge-case network drops during demo.

Confirmed demo + close plan:
- Demo: Thu 07/09 10:00 PT (recording enabled). Staging endpoint: https://staging.api.integracom.com/redwood-integ. Integracom to provide a long-lived test token by EOD Fri.
- MAP milestone: "Integration demo" moves to complete after recording + smoke run. Target close: 2026-07-16 if no regressions.

Action items (owner - due):
- Integracom (Sarah) - share long-lived test token & confirm final payload fields in shared drive (Due: Fri 07/09 EOD)
- Monica - push SDK adapter for field mapping and upload updated SDK build to staging (Done: Fri 07/09)
- Karthik - monitor streaming during the demo and capture logs for any reconnect failures (Due: Demo + 24h)
- Alex - update MAP_Integracom_v2.xlsx with demo outcome and push to HubSpot deal RDW-2345 (Due: Mon 07/12)

Attachments included in this thread: MAP_Integracom_v2.xlsx, auth_test_report.pdf, integration_flow.drawio.png

If there are no objections I'll mark the demo step complete in the MAP on Monday and propose the final close for 07/16. Great progress — thanks team.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
